ItemID: unavailable; Title: III; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough to choose it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Best of Jackie Gleason & His Orchestra: His Original Capitol Recordings; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Orchestral mood music is not what I want after my recent rock and blues listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Live At The Bon Soir; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a vocal nightclub performance right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Better Word; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize this title or see a clear connection to my recent listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Time; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this fits my interests.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Johnny Winter's blues fits my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Looking Back To See - The First Four Albums 1957-1960 ORIGINAL RECORDINGS REMASTERED SET; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of early country recordings is not what I am seeking this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Best of Louis Jordan; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Jump blues has some appeal, but I currently want more guitar-focused music.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would pick this one because the Clapton connection and relaxed blues sound fit my interest in Old Sock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is the Tedeschi Trucks Band album, its soulful blues rock appeals, but I would stick with my one choice today.
